latestVersion.changelog:
Brave API Search v4.2.0 — Major Update

- Added full entity extraction to the `brave_answers` tool via the new `enable-entities` flag (outputs an "Entities mentioned" section on streaming responses).
- Enhanced streaming output for answers with inline entity parsing alongside citations.
- Updated documentation to reflect new entity extraction capabilities and improved response formatting.
- Internal code improvements for entity parsing and output clarity.
